faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLS63 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. From 2012 to 2019 (X166), the GLS63 AMG used the M157 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8. From 2019 onwards (X167), it switched to the M177 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLS63 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLS63 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M157 or the M177 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M157 GLS63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace valve seals, timing chain components, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M157 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M177 GLS63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M177 shares a similar valve seal and coolant system wear pattern, and we service it to the same AMG standard as the M157.

faqLeft.q: Do you supply used GLS63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLS63 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLS63 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLS63 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild GLS63 AMG engines from the X166 generation?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M157-powered X166 GLS63 AMG (including the pre-2016 GL63 AMG) is one of our regular rebuilds — we know this engine well.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild GLS63 AMG engines from the X167 generation?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M177-powered X167 GLS63 AMG is a more recent engine but shares similar AMG V8 characteristics we're thoroughly experienced with.
